programs.title: Project Almanac
programs.desc: When five teens discover a machine that can send them back in time, the possibilities seem endless.  But by changing the past, they have threatened the future of our world.  Can they undo the damage they have unleashed before it’s too late?

programs.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programs.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programs.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programs.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programs.title: Congo
programs.desc: When an explorer’s quest for a diamond mine ends tragically in the Congo, his father and the operation’s CEO sends Dr. Karen Ross, into the jungle to continue the hunt…maybe for his son, but definitely for the diamonds.

programs.title: The Tuxedo
programs.desc: Simmy Tong is an ordinary cabbie-turned-chauffeur who slips into a 2-billion-dollar, super-spy suit and inadvertently becomes a dashing secret agent.

programs.title: Operation Condor
programs.desc: Jackie Chan ignites the big screen as the world's greatest secret agent, code name Condor. Sent to track down stolen Nazi gold, he is pursued by a ruthless band of treasure-hunting terrorists on a globe-spanning quest to reach the bounty first!

programs.title: Wayne's World
programs.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programs.desc: Paramount Movie Channel delivers a 24/7 curated selection of celebrated cinematic hits, blockbusters, and legacy films from Hollywood's longest-operating movie studio library.
